indexer: index an EVM chain and serve it over GraphQL, JSON-RPC, REST and WebSocket.

Usage:
  indexer [flags]              index the chain and serve the API
  indexer <command> [flags]

Commands:
  help          Help about any command
  resume-check  Check the resume conditions after a capacity halt and remove the halt latch
  version       Print the version

Settings are applied in this order, later ones winning:
  defaults < --config file (config.yaml if present) < INDEXER_* environment variables < flags given here
Each flag names the setting it sets and its environment variable in parentheses.
Settings without a flag are set in the file or the environment (see configs/*.yaml).

Configuration file:
      --config string   YAML configuration file; the default is skipped if it does not exist, a given file must exist (default "config.yaml")

Logging:
      --log-format string   Log format: console or json (log.format, $INDEXER_LOG_FORMAT) (default "json")
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn or error (log.level, $INDEXER_LOG_LEVEL) (default "info")

Process role:
      --node-role string   What this process does: all, ingest, api (node.role, $INDEXER_NODE_ROLE) (default "all")

Chain node:
      --rpc string             JSON-RPC endpoint URL of the node (rpc.endpoint, $INDEXER_RPC_ENDPOINT)
      --rpc-fallback strings   Further HTTP(S) endpoints of the same chain, comma-separated, tried in order (rpc.fallback_endpoints, $INDEXER_RPC_FALLBACK_ENDPOINTS)
      --rpc-rate-limit float   HTTP requests per second to the nodes, every attempt included; 0 is unlimited (rpc.rate_limit, $INDEXER_RPC_RATE_LIMIT)
      --rpc-timeout duration   Timeout of one RPC attempt (rpc.timeout, $INDEXER_RPC_TIMEOUT) (default 30s)
      --rpc-ws string          WebSocket endpoint whose newHeads wake the live loop (rpc.ws_endpoint, $INDEXER_RPC_WS_ENDPOINT)

Database:
      --db string          Pebble database directory (database.path, $INDEXER_DB_PATH)
      --db-driver string   Storage: pebble, postgres (the PostgreSQL DSN has no flag) (database.driver, $INDEXER_DB_DRIVER)

Indexing:
      --chunk-size int       Blocks per batch, positive; 1 is real-time mode (indexer.chunk_size, $INDEXER_CHUNK_SIZE) (default 100)
      --confirmations uint   Blocks behind the head with --finality confirmations (indexer.confirmations, $INDEXER_CONFIRMATIONS)
      --era-dir string       Directory of era1 archives read before the node (source.era_dir, $INDEXER_SOURCE_ERA_DIR)
      --finality string      How far the live loop indexes: head, confirmations, finalized (indexer.finality, $INDEXER_FINALITY)
      --mode string          What is ingested: full, declared (only the logs features.records declares) (indexer.mode, $INDEXER_MODE)
      --start-height uint    Block height to start indexing from (indexer.start_height, $INDEXER_START_HEIGHT)
      --workers int          Blocks fetched concurrently (indexer.workers, $INDEXER_WORKERS) (default 100)

API server:
      --api               Serve the API (--api=false turns it off) (api.enabled, $INDEXER_API_ENABLED)
      --api-host string   Address the API listens on (api.host, $INDEXER_API_HOST) (default "localhost")
      --api-port int      Port the API listens on (api.port, $INDEXER_API_PORT) (default 8080)
      --graphql           Serve GraphQL (api.enable_graphql, $INDEXER_API_GRAPHQL)
      --jsonrpc           Serve JSON-RPC (api.enable_jsonrpc, $INDEXER_API_JSONRPC)
      --websocket         Serve WebSocket (api.enable_websocket, $INDEXER_API_WEBSOCKET)

Start:
      --adapter string   Chain profile id (evm) or alias; detected from the node if empty or "auto"
      --clear-data       Delete the databases before starting
      --gap-recovery     Detect and fill missing blocks at startup
      --reindex          Delete the blockchain data before starting, keeping verification data (ABIs, sources)

Other:
  -h, --help      Show this help ('indexer <command> --help' for a command)
  -v, --version   Print the version

Examples:
  indexer --config config.yaml
  indexer --rpc http://127.0.0.1:8545 --db ./data --api
  indexer --config config.yaml --reindex
  indexer resume-check --config /etc/indexer/config.yaml

Documentation: README.md and docs/README.md in the source repository.
